summary: Implemented the Tabs feature in the Textual repo, but nothing was run: all verification was by reading only, so the new and existing tests are unverified. Changes: new src/textual/widgets/tabs.py (Tab, TabsRenderable, Tabs with keyboard handling, search, digit rules, action_range_clicked, and an animated bar_position watcher); UnderlineBar gained clickable_ranges (before width) that attaches range_clicked metadata, with unchanged output when no ranges are given; Opacity now merges color into the existing style so meta is preserved; _layout_resolve gained a concrete LayoutEdge dataclass. Also added docs/reference/tabs.md, a sandbox demo under sandbox/tabs/, the required underline-bar click-range test, and tests/widgets/test_tabs.py. Interpretive choices: letter search only fires for single-character keys; find_tab_by_name returns the last match on name collisions; inactive padding cells also carry the click action; padding is resolved only over padding edges so zero-width labels are not treated as flexible. Nothing was committed. Next step: run pytest tests/renderables tests/widgets and the existing suite to confirm.
